enclosures.name: 12"x12"x18" Exo Terra Small Tall
enclosures.note: Minimum for juveniles and hatchlings only

enclosures.name: 18"x18"x24" Exo Terra Medium Tall
enclosures.note: ReptiFiles minimum for a single adult

enclosures.name: 18"x18"x36" Exo Terra Large Tall
enclosures.note: Ideal for adult — more vertical climbing space

enclosures.name: 24"x18"x36" Large Front-Opening
enclosures.note: Excellent for bioactive setups with live plants

heating.name: 25W Halogen Flood Bulb
heating.description: ReptiFiles top recommendation. Low wattage keeps temps safe. Use with dimmer or thermostat.
heating.safetyNote: Must be paired with a thermostat or dimmer. Never exceed 85°F at basking spot.

heating.name: 35W Halogen Flood Bulb
heating.description: For larger 18x18x36 or 24x18x36 enclosures. Use with dimmer.

heating.name: Ceramic Heat Emitter (CHE) 40W
heating.description: No-light supplemental heat. Use only if room drops below 65°F at night.

heating.name: Inkbird ITC-306T Dimming Thermostat
heating.description: Required with all heat sources. Set probe at basking spot. Target 82-85°F max.
heating.safetyNote: Crested geckos are extremely heat sensitive. Temps above 85°F cause stress, above 90°F can be fatal.

heating.name: Plug-In Lamp Dimmer
heating.description: Simple way to dial down heat bulb wattage. Use instead of or alongside thermostat.

uvb.name: Arcadia ShadeDweller ProT5 Kit (7% UVB, 12")
uvb.description: ReptiFiles #1 recommendation for crested geckos. Low output, perfect for crepuscular species. Place on top of mesh.
uvb.note: Place 10-15" above gecko's highest basking point. Replace every 12 months.

uvb.name: Zoo Med ReptiSun 5.0 Mini CFL 13W
uvb.description: Good budget UVB option for smaller enclosures. Use in a 5.5" dome fixture.

uvb.name: No UVB
uvb.description: Crested geckos can survive without UVB due to their CGD diet, but ReptiFiles strongly recommends it for optimal health.
uvb.warning: Without UVB, ensure calcium supplementation is adequate and consistent

lighting.name: Arcadia JungleDawn LED Bar 17W
lighting.description: Full spectrum LED for plant growth and natural day cycle. Pairs perfectly with ShadeDweller UVB. Essential for live plant bioactive setups.

lighting.name: Zilla 24/7 Digital Power Center Timer
lighting.description: Automate lights on 12-14 hour cycle. Simulates natural day/night. Required for healthy hormonal rhythms.

substrates.name: Zoo Med Eco Earth Coconut Fiber
substrates.description: ReptiFiles recommended. Excellent humidity retention. Pack 3-4" deep.

substrates.name: Bio Dude Terra Fauna Bioactive Substrate
substrates.description: Best for live plant bioactive setups. Use with drainage layer. Supports isopods and springtails.

substrates.name: DIY Tropical Mix (Eco Earth + Organic Topsoil)
substrates.description: 50/50 mix of coconut fiber and organic topsoil. Great humidity retention. Excellent for bioactive.

substrates.name: Paper Towels
substrates.description: For quarantine and hatchlings only. Does not retain humidity. Not suitable for long-term adult care.

humidity.name: Exo Terra Pressure Sprayer 2L
humidity.description: Mist enclosure once in morning and once in evening. Spike humidity to 80%+ then let dry to 40-50% before next misting.

humidity.name: Exo Terra Monsoon Misting System
humidity.description: Programmable automatic mister. Best for consistent humidity cycling. Hands-free.

humidity.name: Zoo Med Combo Digital Thermometer/Humidity Gauge
humidity.description: Place probe in middle of enclosure. Target 40-50% ambient daytime, spike to 80% after misting.

humidity.name: Sphagnum Moss
humidity.description: Use in humid hide and as substrate topper. Retains moisture and boosts humidity. Replace monthly.

decor.name: Cork Bark Tube (Large Hide)
decor.description: Essential hide. Crested geckos need multiple secure hiding spots at all levels — top, middle, and bottom.

decor.name: Exo Terra Coco Hut Coconut Hide
decor.description: Arboreal hide — hang or mount at upper level. Crested geckos love enclosed overhead retreats.

decor.name: Artificial Climbing Vines (5 pack)
decor.description: Fill vertical space for climbing and thermoregulation. Essential — crested geckos need to use all levels.

decor.name: Natural Cork Bark Flat (climbing ledges)
decor.description: Horizontal resting surfaces at multiple heights. Gives gecko options to thermoregulate vertically.

decor.name: Live Pothos / Philodendron Plant
decor.description: Excellent for humidity, enrichment, and hiding cover. Crested geckos thrive with live plant coverage.

decor.name: Artificial Hanging Plants (2 pack)
decor.description: Low maintenance alternative to live plants. Still provides essential cover and enrichment.

decor.name: Small Reptile Water Dish
decor.description: Crested geckos prefer drinking water droplets off leaves, but a small dish is still recommended as backup.

supplements.name: Repashy Crested Gecko Diet (CGD) 3oz
supplements.description: ReptiFiles #1 recommended CGD. Complete diet — mix with water 1:2 ratio. Replace every 24-48 hours.

supplements.name: Pangea Fruit Mix Complete Gecko Diet 2oz
supplements.description: Excellent CGD alternative. Variety helps prevent food boredom. Rotate flavors.

supplements.name: Repti Calcium Without D3
supplements.description: Dust feeder insects lightly 2-3x per week. Use WITHOUT D3 if providing UVB.

supplements.name: Repti Calcium With D3
supplements.description: Use only if NOT providing UVB. 1-2x per week maximum — D3 toxicity is a real risk.
supplements.note: Only if no UVB — do not use with UVB

supplements.name: Repashy Calcium Plus LoD (Low D3)
supplements.description: All-in-one supplement. Use with UVB. Dust insects 1x per week.

enclosure.orientation: TALL not wide — crested geckos are arboreal and need vertical climbing space
enclosure.note: Never use a horizontal enclosure — crested geckos will be stressed without vertical climbing space

temperature.danger: Above 85°F causes stress. Above 90°F can be fatal. This is the #1 killer of crested geckos.

humidity.cycle: Wet/dry cycle is essential — constant high humidity causes respiratory infections and mold

nonNegotiables: Tall enclosure only — minimum 18"x18"x24" for adults
Thermostat or dimmer required on all heat sources
Wet/dry humidity cycling — spike to 80%, dry to 40-50%
Multiple hides at all vertical levels
Dense vines and foliage for climbing and cover
CGD (Crested Gecko Diet) as primary food source
dangerous: Constant high humidity without dry periods — respiratory infection
High D3 supplementation with UVB — toxicity risk
